topic: Handling price shopper calls on a busy route
hook_options: You're in a crawlspace. Phone rings. It's a price shopper.
The plumber who quotes the fastest rarely gets the margin.
We hear the same thing from plumbers all the time: I spend half my day on calls that go nowhere.
How much time do you waste on tire kickers every day?
Calls from people who just want a cheap estimate slow you down.
tweet: You're in a crawlspace. Phone rings. It's someone asking for a ballpark price on a water heater swap. You can't talk. They hang up. Pipeline Reception answers, qualifies the lead, and books the real jobs on your schedule. We set you up in a day. Book a demo at pipelinereception.com
caption:
